The empty-session fallback and fail-closed corruption handling are also present. I only found an environment-edge nit around bootstrap exits, not a spec contradiction.

Within this file, the required gate pieces are present: ledger selection, pending/corrupt counting, live-claim bypass, block-on-close, durable failure logging, and the empty-session fallback. I did not find a missing sub-step in the gate itself. The broader plan’s doc updates and SessionStart sweep live in sibling files, not here.

Placement, naming, and helper sourcing are consistent with the house style for hooks. It uses the shared `_run_in_progress.sh` instead of duplicating claim logic. No forbidden prefixing or obvious source-of-truth violations showed up in this file.
